snippet.title: I've noticed that scarcity usually sounds very final.
snippet.description:
"I can't afford it." "Not possible." "I can't do it." "It's too late for me." 

There's no openness in those statements. No possibility. Your brain just shuts the door and stops looking.

But when you ask "HOW can I afford it? What ideas, resources, connections could I draw on to MAKE IT POSSIBLE?" something shifts. Your brain starts searching for solutions.

Not because you magically become delusional overnight 😅 but because you stop assuming what you want is impossible for you.

I really believe abundance starts there. It doesn’t start with having more money – the money comes after. Stay open. Let the universe show you a different possibility.  

Next time you catch yourself thinking "Meh… I can't afford that" – swap it for "HOW can I afford it?" Then tell me in the comments what came up. 👇
